normalisation: Each transmitted XYZ component is divided by the corresponding blank D65/1931-2° integral and scaled to the IEC D65 reference white (Xn=0.95047, Yn=1, Zn=1.08883) before XYZ-to-sRGB encoding.
sourcePrecision: The local table selects exact 1 nm source rows at 5 nm intervals; it is a derived numerical quadrature artifact, not an indicator spectrum.
admissionReason: Production colourimetry transform/reference data only; it supplies D65/observer integration and sRGB encoding, never missing indicator absorptivity.
